name: aggrega
description: Runs Aggrega as a Model Context Protocol server, so an assistant can compile and inspect a Release and read catalog entities through a structured protocol instead of scraping command output. This package carries no Aggrega program of its own: it launches the aggrega executable already installed on this machine, at the path you supply below.

binary_path.title: Path to the aggrega executable
binary_path.description: Select the aggrega executable already installed on this machine — the same program that runs when you type aggrega version at a terminal. This package launches that program rather than carrying one of its own, so the server does not start until this path is set.

workspace_root.title: Workspace folder
workspace_root.description: Select the folder of the Aggrega workspace the assistant works in — the folder that holds your project's .aggrega-config.yaml. Every request that names no folder of its own is answered in this workspace, so the server does not start until this folder is set.
